description: This file defines a React context provider for managing theme (light/dark mode) state in a React application. It includes a context, provider component, and a custom hook for consuming the context, along with theme toggling logic that interacts with localStorage and the DOM.

methods.name: ThemeProvider
methods.description: React component that provides theme context value and manages theme state, including initialization, toggling, and applying theme classes to document.

methods.name: useTheme
methods.description: Custom hook to access theme context value, throws error if used outside ThemeProvider.
